summary: Iter171 — End-to-end regression of Commerces Proches (Nearby Businesses) wiring. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass (public catalog 22 items spanning all 13 required categories, home nearby section has 10 tiles all deep-linking to /nearby?category=<urlencoded French cat>, admin auth guards return 401 for unauth, admin CRUD POST/PUT/DELETE works with cookie auth, created item appears in public catalog and is removed after delete). Frontend admin: /admin/nearby-businesses lists 22 commerces; Ajouter→fill (form-name/category=Musée/address/rating/distance)→save shows new row with edit-{id}/delete-{id} testids; Edit→change name→save persists; Delete→confirm→row removed. Frontend client deep-link (logged in as buyer@demo.sb / Buyer2026!): /nearby?category=Mus%C3%A9e pre-selects the 'Musée' chip (cat-mus-e has bg-orange-600) and renders exactly 2 cards: Musée du Louvre + Musée d'Orsay. /nearby with no param shows 22 items with 'Tout' chip active.

minor.issue: Public catalog endpoint ignores ?category= filter (returns all 22 categories instead of filtering server-side). Not a bug — frontend filters client-side via ServiceListLayout chips, and the spec implies client-side filtering. Mentioned only for awareness if server-side filtering is later desired.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminNearbyBusinesses.js — uses window.confirm() for delete confirmation (works but not consistent with sonner/shadcn dialogs used elsewhere). Functional, low priority.
ServiceListLayout exposes initialCategory and resets activeCat via useEffect when initialCategory changes — confirmed correct (works for direct deep-link and SPA navigation).

NearbyBusinessPage uses NEARBY_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c === rawCat) for exact match — works correctly with raw or url-encoded category values (browser auto-decodes search params). Verified with %C3%A9 (é) and direct 'Musée'.

Home nearby tiles deep-link routes are correctly urlencoded (Musée -> /nearby?category=Mus%C3%A9e, Hôtel -> /nearby?category=H%C3%B4tel, Café -> /nearby?category=Caf%C3%A9). All 10 tile target_routes pass the decode-and-validate check.
Admin endpoints require admin role and return 401 (unauth). Cookie-based auth works (access_token cookie set on login).
test_credentials: admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! (admin); buyer@demo.sb / Buyer2026! (client email login via /login -> other options -> Email)
seed_data_creation: Created+deleted 1 transient business per pytest run (TEST_BUSINESS_<rand>) and 1 transient business per UI run (TEST_UI_BUSINESS_xyz123) — both cleaned up by the same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter171 verified the Commerces Proches wiring requested in the review. pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter171_nearby_businesses.py covers public catalog count+categories, home-categories nearby section deep-link routes (urlencoded), admin auth guards, and full admin CRUD (POST/PUT/DELETE) with cookie auth. Frontend admin CRUD verified via Playwright on /admin/nearby-businesses with all data-testids (add-business-btn, form-name/category/address/rating/distance, dialog-save, edit-{id}, delete-{id}, business-row-{id}). Client deep-link verified by logging in as buyer@demo.sb / Buyer2026! via /login (Other options -> login-email-btn -> email-input/password-input/email-login-submit-btn) then navigating to /nearby?category=Mus%C3%A9e (cat-mus-e chip becomes active, only Musée du Louvre + Musée d'Orsay render) and to /nearby (cat-all active, 22 items). No regressions found.
